window.guide: AIC_V6_后续10小时研究与执行指南_20260929.md

e3_deployment_chain.goal: raw MP4 -> YouTube-8M-compatible frame features (rgb1024+audio128 quantized) -> frozen E2/T0 head -> temporal prediction
e3_deployment_chain.rgb_route: official TF feature extractor (InceptionV3 + YT-8M PCA) on CPU, isolated env; torch port fallback
e3_deployment_chain.audio_route: VGGish official weights + PCA params (torch port acceptable, weights byte-checked)
e3_deployment_chain.parity_sample: 1-3 MrHiSum-listed YouTube videos downloaded via workstation proxy; feature-level comparison (dequantized L2/cosine per step after best-offset alignment); if download blocked, local raw videos with parity explicitly UNVERIFIED
e3_deployment_chain.notes: no TF on V100 (cv env); 1fps YT-8M frame features; 300s coverage rule per sample must be checked against steps

control.def: E2 config re-run with weight saving: TemporalUNet(1152), masked_regression, AdamW lr1e-3 wd1e-4, bs16, 3 epochs, seed 20260929
control.expected: dev macro Spearman 0.288 +/- 0.013 run-to-run variance documented in V6_E2/det_ab.log

new_candidates.def: TemporalTCN(1152): adapter->128, 4 dilated residual ConvBlocks (d 1,2,4,8) at full temporal resolution, no pooling/interpolate decode, output Conv1d->1; params budget <= 2.5M
new_candidates.hypothesis: removing down/upsample keeps signal and removes the nondeterministic-interpolate variance source; dev Spearman >= T0 with smaller seed variance

new_candidates.def: T0 skeleton + intra-video pairwise margin ranking loss on 64 uniformly sampled valid pairs per video, lambda=0.5 (preregistered), same optimizer/epochs
new_candidates.hypothesis: explicit ranking objective improves dev Spearman and transfers better to native labels than pure regression

screen.data: release train (25,069) / dev (2,808) npz caches at /data/aic/experiments/V6_E2/npz
screen.rule: a new candidate advances to multi-seed iff dev Spearman - T0_same_seed >= +0.002

multi_seed.budget: 3 seeds x at most 2 configs (control T0 always re-seeded for variance reference)
multi_seed.report: per-seed dev Spearman, mean +/- sd, paired per-video deltas vs T0 per seed

confirm_one_shot.data: release confirmation 4,008 videos (fresh reserve, never used for selection)
confirm_one_shot.rule: run ONCE for at most the 2 best configs after multi-seed freeze; export-confirm npz before that

data_candidates: YouTubeHighlights raw 419 mp4 + local annotations (ledger: T3/T4 selection-exposed 124 groups -> diagnostic only)
E1 native portrait labels (LABELS_MISSING as of T0)
target_domain_transfer.prereq: E3 extractor output on those raw videos; if absent -> TRANSFER_NOT_VERIFIED, stated explicitly
target_domain_transfer.stop_condition: weak-domain improve + target-domain (when measurable) degrade => close package route for that config

e4_temporal_candidates.package_rule: no candidate package from weak-label Spearman alone; needs prereg promotion gate (see promotion)

e5_lfm_zero_shot.env: V100 physical GPU4, isolated PYTHONPATH install (transformers>=5.1 pinned), cv env untouched; V100 fp16 only (no bf16), eager/sdpa attention as validated

protocol.smoke: 10 keyframes from configs/LFM450_SPATIAL_DEV_MANIFEST_V1.json videos; verify load, parse, bbox legality, latency
protocol.pilot: 50 videos x up to 6 sampled keyframes, layers nonperson/fast_motion/shot_cuts/regular as manifest
arms: S0 center crop at target ratio (geometric baseline)
S1 LFM bbox -> validated geometry to legal crop window
S2 fixed legal candidate selection only if S1 passes checks
protocol.decoding: greedy; mechanical format fixes only, all raw replies retained
protocol.engineering_threshold: >=99% parseable without manual rescue (preregistered engineering bar, not an accuracy bar)

e5_lfm_zero_shot.metrics: per-frame raw output, parse/fallback status, out-of-range rate, per-arm geometry validity stratified by layer/ratio, latency, peak memory; NO fabricated IoU (no human boxes), no teacher-agreement as accuracy

temporal_grid_probe.def: 2x2 grid of 4 timestamps vs single center frame, same visual-token budget, fixed keep/skip judgment format
temporal_grid_probe.status: interface/behavior exploration only unless native temporal labels exist; not a model-gain claim

e1_auto_native_supervision.human_annotation: NONE (user will not annotate and assigns no annotators; supersedes earlier E1 UI/wait-for-labels plan)
e1_auto_native_supervision.public_labels: reuse existing public/in-house labels as-is; auto-organize train/dev/confirm with original label semantics and source grouping; never rename exposed data into a fresh confirmation set

teacher_pseudo.task: crop-candidate preference + temporal pseudo-labels on native-portrait videos of the LEGAL training pool only; competition test videos forbidden
teacher_pseudo.pilot: 20-40 videos, measure throughput + retention before any scale-up; timebox 1-2h total
teacher_pseudo.qc: automated format/geometry/candidate-order/transform-consistency checks; low quality dropped or downweighted; consistency is a filtering basis only, never presented as label accuracy
teacher_pseudo.abstain_rule: teacher unavailable or gains insufficient => continue public-label-only training; never stall on this

e1_auto_native_supervision.training_contrast: public-labels-only vs public-labels+filtered-pseudo; gains evaluated ONLY on existing public ground truth; teacher-agreement reported separately; native-portrait independent GT absent => effects marked UNVERIFIED
e1_auto_native_supervision.shared_encoder_feasibility: cache LFM SigLIP2-NaFlex ~86M vision-tower features on local raw videos, train one small head as signal probe; parameters counted after export; no dim-matching across encoders

promotion_gate.rule: clean-confirm paired gain mean >0 AND source-clustered 95% CI lower bound >0 vs locked deployable student baseline; native-portrait layer must not degrade beyond -0.002 F tolerance (engineering suggestion, frozen before results)
promotion_gate.note: local evidence only; no official-score prediction; official best stays INTERP 48.67 until platform feedback
